name: Worth Buying Deal Discovery Network
objective: Continuously identify high-intent, genuinely strong deals and emerging purchase opportunities for Worth Buying UK and Worth Buying USA, then turn only the best opportunities into original editorial content.

live_commerce: eBay production Browse API for live listings, item details and affiliate URLs
Amazon public product, launch and deal pages using approved affiliate-link methods only
official retailer sale, clearance and launch pages
manufacturer launch pages and official product announcements
demand_signals: Google Search and Google Discover interest signals
current product-launch news and retailer visibility
public deal-community activity as a demand signal only
social and creator buzz where it indicates real purchase intent

community_rules: Do not automate self-promotion or affiliate-link posting into deal communities that prohibit it.
Use public deal communities such as HotUKDeals or Slickdeals as trend and demand signals only unless their current rules explicitly permit a business/publisher partnership.
Never scrape or bypass access restrictions.
Do not copy another publisher's wording, ranking, images or analysis. Create original Worth Buying editorial content.
verification_rules: Never describe a product as a deal purely because a retailer displays a crossed-out RRP.
Verify current price and availability immediately before mentioning them.
Where previous price history is unavailable, describe value without claiming a percentage saving.
Do not invent discount percentages, coupon codes, stock levels, ratings, review counts or expiry times.
Prefer deals from reputable retailers or sellers with clear returns and buyer protection.
Separate genuinely time-limited deal posts from evergreen buying guides.
content_types: Deal Alert - one unusually strong current offer
Today's Best Deals - a tightly curated multi-product roundup
Price Drop Worth Buying - a verified material reduction on a strong product
Launch Deal - launch product plus immediate accessory or bundle opportunity
Refurbished Deal - unusually strong value with condition and seller checks
Seasonal Deal Hub - Black Friday, Prime-style events, Christmas, back-to-school, summer and other high-intent periods
Viral Product Check - whether a fast-rising product is actually worth buying

distribution.blogger: Only publish after Blogger API access is restored and the site safety flag is deliberately enabled.
distribution.x: Only promote a live article URL and mark the commercial link clearly as Affiliate.
distribution.pinterest: Only promote a live article URL and use original Worth Buying creative.
distribution.google_discover: Optimise timely articles for people-first Discover eligibility without clickbait or misleading urgency.
distribution.future_email: Add an opt-in Worth Buying Deals email when there is enough recurring content and audience demand.

future_network_priority: Awin for broad UK retail coverage
impact.com for US/global brand and product discovery
CJ Affiliate for additional major brands and APIs
Rakuten Advertising for further premium retailer coverage
